Package org.apache.juneau.bean.mcp.v20260728

Class InputRequiredResult

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.bean.mcp.v20260728.Result<InputRequiredResult>
org.apache.juneau.bean.mcp.v20260728.InputRequiredResult
@Marshalled public class InputRequiredResult extends Result<InputRequiredResult>
Result of a tools/call, prompts/get, or resources/read handler pausing to request more input (MCP 2026-07-28 SEP-2322 Multi-Round-Trip Requests).

Carries a server-assigned-id-keyed map of requested inputs (getInputRequests()) and/or an opaque, tamper-evident continuation token (getRequestState()). The pinned schema requires at least one of the two to be present; a caller must treat requestState as a black box, meaningful only to the codec that sealed it.

inputRequests is lossless. Each value is a full sub-request object exactly as the pinned schema models it (a sampling/roots/elicitation sub-request), typed as a raw JsonMap so a handler-supplied map reaches the wire byte-for-byte — there is no synthetic {type, payload} envelope, and no member is relocated or dropped. Concrete sub-request shapes are owned by the eventual consumers of this mechanism (C5 sampling, C6 elicitation), neither of which is defined by this class. This mirrors the equally free-form shape of the request-side inputResponses map.
